The present petition is filed under section 482 Cr.P.C for quashing of FIR bearing no. 0555/2015 dated 28.07.2015 registered under sections 498A/406/34 IPC and section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 at P.S. Seelampur, Delhi along with consequential proceedings.

2. The petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 got married on 23.03.2014 according to Muslim rites and customs and out of their marriage, one female child, namely, Afia was born on 11.05.2015,
who at present is under the care and custody of the respondent no. 2.
The petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 due to matrimonial differences, started to live separately w.e.f. 27.07.2014 without any cohabitation.

4.

The respondent no. 2 also got registered FIR bearing no. 0555/2015 under sections 498A/406/34 IPC and section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 at P.S Seelampur wherein the petitioners were implicated.
The petitioners no. 2 to 5 are the family members/relatives of the petitioner no. 1.
The petitioners and the respondent no. 2 are identified by their respective counsel.

After conclusion of investigation, the charge-sheet has already been filed and the trial is stated to be pending in the court of Ms. Arushi Pariwal, MM, North-East District, Karkardooma Courts, Delhi/Successor Court.

Karkardooma Courts for settlement whereby the petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 have settled their disputes vide Settlement dated 02.12.2021 wherein the petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 have agreed to dissolve their marriage as per Islamic law.

The petitioner no. 1 has agreed to pay Rs.6,80,000/- (Rupees Six Lacs and Eighty Thousand Only) to the respondent no. 2 towards full and final settlement of all the legal entitlements (past, present and future) arising out of marriage between the petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 including

It is stated that the petitioner no. 1 has already paid Rs.5,80,000/- to the respondent no. 2, which is acknowledged by the respondent no. 2.

The petitioner no. 1 delivered demand draft bearing no. 001103 dated 20.10.2023 drawn on HDFC Bank amounting to Rs.1,00,000/- towards payment of balance settled amount to the respondent no. 2, which is accepted by the counsel for the respondent no. 2 on behalf of the respondent no. 2.
6. The marriage between the petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 has already been dissolved on 01.04.2022 as per Islamic laws.

7. The counsel for the petitioners stated that as the disputes between the petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 have already been settled vide Settlement dated 02.12.2021 and their marriage has already been dissolved as per Islamic law as such, the present petition be allowed and FIR bearing no. 0555/2015 be quashed along with consequential judicial proceedings.
8.

The respondent no.2 stated that she has settled with the petitioner no.1 out of her free own will and without any force and coercion and her marriage with the petitioner no. 1 has already been dissolved as per Islamic law.

The respondent no.2 further stated she has already received the entire settled amount as such, she does not have any objection if the present petition is allowed and FIR Yusuf And Ors vs State Of Nct Of Delhi & Anr on 14 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/54169003/

sentences.text: The petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 got married on 23.03.2014 as per Islamic law and due to matrimonial differences, they started to live separately w.e.f. 27.07.2014 without any cohabitation.

The petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 have already settled their pending disputes vide Settlement dated 02.12.2021, the terms and conditions of which have already been executed and the respondent no. 2 has already received the entire settled amount.
The marriage between the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no. 2 has already been dissolved as per Islamic law.

No useful purpose would be served if the proceedings arising out of the present FIR are allowed to be continued and it would be an exercise in futility.
11.

After considering all facts, the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no. 0555/2015 registered under sections 498A/406/34 IPC and section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 at P.S.
Seelampur is quashed along with consequential proceedings including judicial proceedings stated to be pending before the court of Ms. Arushi Pariwal, MM, North-East District, Karkardooma Courts,
Delhi/Successor Court.
